title: Bounty boards and clearer fights
changes: Bounty boards stand on the Market Square and beside every portal stone. Pick a hunt that fits your level; it pays XP and gold the moment the last monster falls.
The monster under your mouse or under attack shows its name, damage numbers are bigger, and your own name steps aside when a monster stands right next to you.
Gold is picked up from a couple of steps away.
Item finds no longer hide behind the quest tracker, and the first quest's skill hint matches the new keys.
